description:
Why are you looking to other people to tell you who you are?

Why does a strangers approval feel so important to you that you can’t even approach them?

You do realize the only person who can decide if your worthy is you, don’t you?

Do you think women want a shy little boy asking the world who he is?

Or a man who KNOWS HIMSELF so well - NOTHING can phase him

Complete self confidence is a MAGNET to feminine women

And you started this life TRUSTING YOURSELF until someone conditioned it out of you

Let go of the past

Step into the present moment with CONFIDENCE

The only person who can tell you who you are is YOU

Sort yourself out

And your dating life will as well

Simple.
transcript: Most guys will never realize how attractive women find you when you're actually composed. When you've stopped looking for validation in the external world, where you're not sure who you are and you need people's approval, and if they don't approve of you, that makes you feel like you're worthless. When you've gotten beyond that nonsense of doing that game and you truly love yourself, you're like a magnet for feminine energy. Anytime you're out talking with women They can tell that you really don't care, that you feel good about yourself, that you love yourself, and it draws them closer towards you. Because that means you're a stable guy. You have some reason for being confident in her eyes. But again, the reason can just be that you love yourself. That's just as attractive as if you have a million dollars in the bank account or you've created some massive business it doesn't matter what matters more is the energy that you're coming from right so if there's one quality that you could adopt that's really gonna change your dating life it's just to stop looking for people to validate you validate yourself and then go enjoy conversations go enjoy meeting up with people go enjoy connecting and communicating but stop trying to find yourself in other people's approval because it just doesn't work
